name: Arugal's Folly

angles.text: As Forsaken of the Sepulcher, you help uncover the worgen outbreak's true nature in Silverpine. That knowledge matters as Lordaeron faces feral threats it cannot control.
As a Horde adventurer, you help Dalar Dawnweaver protect Silverpine Forest from feral predators and nearby human settlements suffering the affliction.
As a mage, you can see the difference between Dalar's binding enchantments and the affliction spreading among the worgen.

aliases: where do i turn in arugals folly
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver gives and receives the work at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He is a Forsaken mage who studies the arcane.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Arugal's Folly?

aliases: what does dalar think of arugal
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver believes Archmage Arugal lacked the power to create the worgen. He says Arugal could only bind them briefly, not bring them or their affliction into being.
faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver consider Arugal a fraud?

faq.answer: You find the worgen south of the Sepulcher near the Greymane Wall. They prowl by nearby human settlements, and their remains provide samples for Dalar's study.
faq.q: Where do you find the worgen bits for Dalar?

aliases: is there a cure for worgen
faq.answer: Dalar discovers no cure for the worgen affliction. Since Arugal did not create it, his remedies and counter-spells cannot help, and the Forsaken must seek a true solution elsewhere.
faq.q: Does Dalar find a cure for the worgen curse?

faq.answer: Near the Greymane Wall, the affliction appears to spread to nearby humans through physical encounters and bites. Dalar finds no sign of an overarching ritual or spell cast by Arugal.
faq.q: How is the worgen affliction spreading near the Greymane Wall?

aliases: what does dalar learn from the bits
faq.answer: The worgen remains convince Dalar Dawnweaver that Arugal's sorcery did not cause their curse. They confirm Arugal's limited magic, while the affliction remains active and unexplained, with no working antidote.
faq.q: What does Dalar conclude after inspecting the worgen bits?

sections.body: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Forsaken mage Dalar Dawnweaver means to strip away the mystery around his rival, Archmage Arugal. Enchanted shackles show that Arugal lacked the power to summon or create the worgen packs terrorizing the region. His magic could only hold the beasts for a time. How the affliction began remains unknown.
sections.title: Exposing the Archmage

sections.body: Dalar sends you south to the Greymane Wall for proof. Feral worgen attack and infect nearby human populations in the wilderness around its imposing fortifications. You can bring Dalar physical evidence by killing the beasts and gathering pieces of their bodies. He needs those samples to study the affliction's nature.
sections.title: The Beastly Incursion

sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver inspects the worgen remains and claims victory over Arugal's reputation. The archmage had no part in the affliction's origin. Yet this finding brings grim news to the Forsaken. If Arugal did not create the curse, then his supposed remedies and countermeasures are worthless. The worgen outbreak remains unexplained.
sections.title: A Bitter Vindication

summary: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver seeks the truth behind the worgen near the Greymane Wall. He hopes their remains will prove that Archmage Arugal bound the beasts but did not bring their curse into being.
